Shift Maintenance Technician Role Purpose To provide maintenance (i.e. service, repair or replacement) services on all facilities’ plant and equipment to enable effective and efficient operations at our Muir of Ord facility. Key Accountabilities As part of a dedicated Maintenance team, carry out a key role providing Maintenance support to both new and existing plant, in order to maintain operational viability. Maintain and improve our plant and equipment to achieve optimum levels of efficiency, output, quality and safety. Complete scheduled inspection/maintenance activities and ensure adequate information is recorded as required. Position will require craftsman to undertake both mechanical and electrical task. (Training will be provided both in-house and by recognised providers). Communicate as required with the Production Manager/Shift Leader/Team Leader before, during and after working on plant and equipment to maintain communication and ensure common understanding. Complete Maintenance as required on all other site facilities/infrastructure. Complete data entry and interrogate the preventive maintenance system as required in order to ensure appropriate records are established and maintained. Carry out all activities in a safe and tidy manner, leaving all working areas clean and tidy, in compliance with Environmental and Health & Safety requirements, and the 5S Principles. Comply with all aspects of the Company’s Health & Safety Policies and Procedures to minimise risk to self and others. Participate in Process Improvement and Quality initiatives to enhance operational performance. Maintain records as requested to support process improvements. The Shift Tech position consists of day and night working following a continental shift pattern; this will include weekend working. Preferred Knowledge / Skills / Experiences Minimum HNC, SVQ/NVQ level 2 or 3 or other equivalent in a relevant Electrical/Mechanical Discipline and/or recognised apprenticeship in Electrical/Mechanical Maintenance. Must have proven electrical / mechanical maintenance experience within a process manufacturing environment. Candidates who have gas burner experience would be at a distinct advantage. 18th Edition IEE Regulations essential for electricians. Experience in fault finding on systems/PLC’s would also be desirable. Knowledge and understanding of Production Operations and Processes. Intermediate IT skills would be an advantage. Willing to gain and use new and different skills. Experience in working to statutory and company requirements on Health & Safety, Quality and Environment. Adaptability. Evidence of setting high work standards and a commitment to quality. Commitment to achieving and maintaining a high level of safety. Our promise: Your workplace safety is our top priority. Timely salary payments? That's a given with us. We also foster a strong team spirit and value open communication – your opinion matters. Through regular feedback sessions, we support your professional development and ensure that you feel comfortable in your role and can fully utilize your skills. Join Our Team! As one of the world's leading companies in developing and manufacturing specialty graphite, carbon fibers, and composite materials, we create innovative solutions for today's major challenges: mobility, energy, and digitalization. With around 3,800 employees across 28 sites worldwide, we are dedicated to shaping the future through our products and technologies. Our work not only advances industry but also benefits society and reduces environmental impact. Join us and become part of a great team! We strongly encourage all qualified applicants to apply, regardless of gender, age, disability, origin, religion, or sexual orientation.
